verdict.rationale: Flagright's homepage claims in-product 'explainable AI agents' for AML operations and 'AI-native workflows' in case management. That implies AI-generated analysis of the user's compliance data, but the evidence is only one-line marketing taglines. The docs MCP server serves documentation, not insights from customer data, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of what insights or suggestions the AI agents produce, how they surface in the UI, which data they analyze, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
